prerequisites: Node.js 20.10+, npm, Git; install your chosen coding agent and configure provider credentials separately.

capabilities.title: First run
capabilities.summary: Run one small, verifiable change with your chosen coding agent.
details: The yy and yylo launchers are equivalent. Initialize a project, inspect local workspace health, then deliberately choose whether to contact a provider.
Agent invocations can use paid providers. Start with a read-only question; keep prompts in files when they contain shell-sensitive text.
commands: yy pi --no-session 'Summarize this repository. Do not edit files.'
capabilities.boundary: Provider authentication and model availability belong to the agent, not YYLO.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Bounded command loops
capabilities.summary: Repeat a short sequence without hiding its stop conditions.
details: The outer loop uses -n/--iterations; -i/--max-iterations bounds work inside one agent invocation. Commands remain literal and sequential.
Reusable YAML can declare iterations, continuity, on_error and ordered run steps. Choose failure behavior deliberately.
commands: yy loop -n 2 --step 'yy pi "Implement one verified increment"' --step 'npm test'
capabilities.boundary: Iteration limits do not grant spending, integration or production authority.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Sessions and models
capabilities.summary: Continue work without reconstructing it from terminal scrollback.
details: Use continue, clone, branches, switch and continuity for explicit session context. Model aliases are agent-specific; inspect installed help rather than assuming the same alias across agents.
commands:
yy pi --help
yy continue --help
yy continuity --help
capabilities.boundary: Provider sessions and project task state are different sources of truth.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Observe commands and validation
capabilities.summary: Retain bounded command output and exact-input validation evidence.
details: Watch records local command execution; status and await inspect its retained terminal state. Use the ID printed by exec.
Task evidence commands retain validation against exact inputs. Producing evidence does not finish or merge a task.
commands:
yy watch exec pwd
# Use the printed run ID
yy watch status RUN_ID
yy watch await RUN_ID

yy evidence run TASK_ID
yy evidence status TASK_ID
capabilities.boundary: Observation does not acquire lifecycle ownership.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Task lifecycle and native Git delivery
capabilities.summary: Start a task worktree, validate a clean commit, then land exactly that task.
details: Run lifecycle commands from the registered metadata controller: the checkout owning task state. Implementation belongs in the feature worktree printed by task start, never the protected integration checkout.
Start freezes the target and completes configured dependency hydration. Preflight is read-only; finish queues a clean committed candidate. The target owner separately runs land.
Native merge performs no model calls, reviewer selection or test scheduling. Tests and reviews are explicit project checks. A moved target requires recomposition; preserve conflicts and dirty files.
Git integration and Ledger projection are separate. Successful land attempts projection automatically; use project only to retry a failed or stale projection, not to repeat integration.
Stable 0.2.2 uses the earlier merge-queue surface. Do not run the native commands below on that version; inspect installed help or intentionally install the verified prerelease.
commands:
yy task start TASK_ID
# Enter the returned worktree, implement, test and commit.
# Return to the controller.
yy task preflight TASK_ID
yy task finish TASK_ID
yy merge status TASK_ID
# Target owner only:
yy merge land TASK_ID
capabilities.boundary: Push, deployment, package publication and cleanup require separate authorization.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Versioned machine output
capabilities.summary: Read strict JSON or NDJSON rather than parsing terminal prose.
details: Task, merge and integration commands support --format json|ndjson --raw. Capabilities publishes command-specific projections. Ledger independently supports -f json|ndjson --raw.
commands:
yy capabilities --format json --raw
yy merge --format json --raw status
capabilities.boundary: Consumers must inspect schema and projection versions; stdout data is distinct from diagnostics.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Install agent skills
capabilities.summary: Install the independent seven-skill package explicitly.
details: YYLO stages acquisition, validates the selected skill tree and copies it to Claude, Codex and Pi locations. Differing or customized local skills are preserved unless replacement is explicitly authorized.
Install and update use the network; list and status are local reads. There is no silent skill refresh during ordinary product commands.
commands:
yy skills install
yy skills status
capabilities.boundary: Skill instructions are not bundled runtime behavior. Review the selected version before installation.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Tmux workspaces
capabilities.summary: Organize local agent terminals and inspect workspace completion state.
details: The source tree contains session, window, unread and monitor commands. Documentation of their availability is deliberately separate from the package version number.
Inspect the installed command before use. A source checkout does not prove this surface exists in a published artifact.
capabilities.boundary: Source-only evidence: no published capability claim is made for tmux here.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: Source command and tests inspected; no published-artifact verification.

capabilities.title: Managed scripts and workflows
capabilities.summary: Use parallel execution for independent work and workflows for ordered steps.
details: Fresh initialization installs managed scripts. Scripts update preserves customized files and reports conflicts; do not force replacement casually.
Workflow Runner retains rendered commands, stdout, stderr, responses, session IDs and manifests. Lint and dry-run a reviewed workflow before execution.
Parallel Runner caps fan-out; dependencies must remain explicit. Its per-item JSON and aggregation files are stronger evidence than terminal scrollback.
commands:
yy scripts update
./.juno_task/scripts/workflow_runner.sh lint --workflow workflow.yaml
./.juno_task/scripts/workflow_runner.sh --workflow workflow.yaml --dry-run
capabilities.boundary: Workflow storage in Ledger is separate from execution by a runner.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Independent packages and compatibility
capabilities.summary: Use standalone Ledger and Benchmark, or compatible YYLO delegates.
details: Install all packages independently. Delegation preserves the canonical package command surface; it is not a bundled implementation.

Exact compatibility policies vary by CLI version. Stable CLI 0.2.2 and latest stable Ledger need not be compatible: use standalone yylo-ledger or a verified compatible CLI prerelease. Check installed diagnostics rather than mixing versions blindly.
commands:
yy ledger --help
yy benchmark --help
yy doctor workspace
capabilities.boundary: Current CLI source admits Ledger 0.3.1; this does not retroactively change older CLI releases.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.
